basis: Biliary inflammation is hepatic; bacterial infection accounts for most clinical cholangitis, with immune-mediated forms also represented.

decisions.infectious_immune: primary: most clinical cases are bacterial infections; immune-mediated forms also qualify, although inflammation alone would not establish this axis.

basis: Phosphate deficiency causes defective bone mineralization. Hormonal renal phosphate wasting does not establish intrinsic kidney injury across this umbrella.

decisions.renal: none: phosphate wasting is often hormonally mediated; intrinsic renal damage affecting at least 30% independently of treatment is not established.

basis: Lymphatic dysfunction and distichiasis define the syndrome. Kyphosis in 2/5 patients supports structural skeletal involvement (~40%); prevalence precision is limited.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: HPO records structural kyphosis in 2/5 patients (~40%), meeting the frequency threshold; weakness alone would not suffice.

basis: Cleft palate, structural midfacial hypoplasia and sensorineural hearing loss define the syndrome.

decisions.musculoskeletal: primary: explicitly defining midfacial hypoplasia is a structural skeletal abnormality, beyond nonspecific facial appearance.

basis: Mitochondrial complex I dysfunction defines the metabolic spectrum; cardiac, neurologic, ocular and skin abnormalities vary by subtype without established umbrella frequencies.

decisions.cardiovascular: none: cardiomyopathy is a recognized presentation, but involvement in at least 30% across the heterogeneous umbrella is not established.

basis: A cavernous blood-vessel lesion arising in the colon; vascular origin and colonic location both define the disease.

decisions.cardiovascular: primary: the lesion arises from blood vessels themselves, which belong to the cardiovascular axis.

basis: Riboflavin transport defect causes motor neuron disease and deafness; muscle atrophy occurs in 30-79%. Respiratory failure is neuromuscular; optic injury occurs in 5-29%.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: documented skeletal muscle atrophy in 30-79% represents structural tissue loss within the neuromuscular disease, beyond weakness alone.

basis: Classical complement immunodeficiency; discoid lupus in 2/2 and meningitis in 1/1 assessed patients are separately diagnosed associated diseases.

decisions.dermatologic: none: discoid lupus is a separately diagnosed autoimmune disease associated with C1q deficiency; its reported 2/2 frequency does not override that exclusion.

basis: Immune-mediated CNS demyelination includes direct optic nerve injury in roughly half over the MS course; frequency in this progressive subtype is less certain.

decisions.ocular: involved: optic nerve demyelination is an integral MS lesion, with clinical optic neuritis in roughly 50% over the course; subtype-specific frequency is uncertain.

basis: Intestinal atresia/enterocolitis and immunodeficiency define disease. Hepatitis in 1/1 assessed patient does not establish common intrinsic injury independent of parenteral nutrition.

decisions.hepatic: none: liver failure may reflect parenteral nutrition; hepatitis in one assessed patient does not establish direct, treatment-independent liver damage in at least 30%.
